title: 162nd J.C. Bose Birth Anniversary Lecture
teaser: 162nd J.C. Bose Birth Anniversary Lecture jointly presented by The Academy Trust, Sir J.C. Bose Trust Kolkata, and Indian Academy of Sciences. Speaker: Prof. Ashutosh Sharma, Secretary to Govt. of India (DST).
homepageMatter: On 30 November 2020, The Academy Trust, Sir J.C. Bose Trust Kolkata, and the Indian Academy of Sciences jointly presented the 162nd J.C. Bose Birth Anniversary Lecture. Prof. Ashutosh Sharma, Secretary to the Government of India (DST) and Institute Fellow at IIT Kanpur, spoke on "To Come a Full Circle: The Brave New World of Science is the World of J.C. Bose".
